Information for Tenderer/Consultant :
Eligibility of Tenderer : 1. Suppliers should have 5 years’ experience in BD market.
2. Supplier shall provide at least 2 Satisfactory Completion Certificate of Supplying IT and related equipment in the
government/semi government organization in the last two (02) years.
3. The Supplier must have the track record of honoring a single tender of min Taka 15 Lac on of Supplying IT and related
equipment in the last two (02) years in the government/semi government with e-GP ID.
4. The Supplier should have the Bank solvency Certificate. The minimum amount of liquid assets or working capital or credit
facilities of the Tenderer shall be Tk 15 Lac.
5. Suppliers should have Manufacturer Authorization certificate for Video conference system unit.
6. Suppliers shall be a registered (Ltd.) company of Bangladesh with proper documents of Up-to-date Trade License, Valid TIN
Certificate, and VAT Registration/BIN.
7. Tenderer shall furnish the average annual turnover at least 15 lacs (sum of 45 Lac for three years) over the best three (03) years
in last 5(five) years.
8. Must Have office / Sub office in Chittagong for instant support and service.
